description.value:
The Force sings with both harmony and discord, and those who follow the Path of Meditation learn to conduct both. Trained in the ancient art of battle meditation, these sentinels stand at the edge of a fight, less a blade than a guiding hand that shapes how the whole battle unfolds.

Through calm focus they steady their allies' resolve and unravel their enemies' composure, turning the tide of combat without needing to land a single blow themselves.
